english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something meets stated requirements, rules, or specifications.
Use this when something agrees with, conforms to, or matches a standard or usage.
Use this when something is in accordance with, consistent with, or agrees with a rule, standard, or requirement.
Use this when a proposal, condition, or requirement satisfies a standard or requirement.
Use this when something agrees with or matches a standard, pattern, or actual usage rather than merely showing it.
